page.layout: One printed page (right). Running head at top centre "MEDICVS" with page number 85 at top right. Main text: a bracketed synopsis (diagram) of syrups and waters, left part of the page, followed by a paragraph of running text in roman and italic, then a catchword-like line "D DE SYRV" at the foot. A faint left-hand page fragment (show-through and edge of neighbouring page) is not transcribed.

main_text.p: SYrupos hodie practici aquis distillatis cōmiscere solent, & ita potandos præbent, obseruantq; ut sit dupla aquarum mensura ad unam syruporum. Syrupo-rum autem & aquarum mixtionis quantitas non transcendere debet· unc. iiij. Exhibentur uero omnes Syrupi magna ex parte summo mane: interdum etiam uesperi, circa ingressum lecti, illi potissimum, qui somni conciliandi gratia sumuntur.

page.notes: The synopsis is a bracketed diagram; the printed Latin in the left-hand bracket group is "Bilē atrā", with the two groups "Clementiora" and "Valentiora". The initial "S" of the paragraph is a large initial joined to "Yrupos" as printed ("SYrupos"). The faint text at the left edge and in the background belongs to the neighbouring page (show-through) and is not transcribed. Word "Syrupi" and "Syrupo-rum" follow the print.
